title.en: The Yangtze & the Three Gorges Dam

clips.send: Nanjing. Nanjing (南京), an ancient capital, sits on the lower river. Ocean-going ships can sail upstream as far as here.
clips.text: Nanjing. Nanjing (南京), an ancient capital, sits on the lower river. Ocean-going ships can sail upstream as far as here.

clips.send: Hukou: end of the middle reaches. Hukou (湖口 “lake mouth”) in Jiangxi, where Poyang Lake — China’s largest freshwater lake — joins, divides the middle and lower reaches.
clips.text: Hukou: end of the middle reaches. Hukou (湖口 “lake mouth”) in Jiangxi, where Poyang Lake — China’s largest freshwater lake — joins, divides the middle and lower reaches.

clips.send: Yichang: end of the upper reaches. Yichang (宜昌) marks the end of the upper reaches (about 4,500 km). Here the river leaves the mountains for the flat Jianghan Plain.
clips.text: Yichang: end of the upper reaches. Yichang (宜昌) marks the end of the upper reaches (about 4,500 km). Here the river leaves the mountains for the flat Jianghan Plain.

clips.send: Yushu: the Jinsha River begins. After the Tuotuo and Tongtian rivers, the Yangtze becomes the Jinsha (“gold-sand”) River and plunges south through the deep valleys of the Hengduan Mountains.
clips.text: Yushu: the Jinsha River begins. After the Tuotuo and Tongtian rivers, the Yangtze becomes the Jinsha (“gold-sand”) River and plunges south through the deep valleys of the Hengduan Mountains.

clips.send: The Jing River bends and Dongting Lake. Below Yichang the river slows and wanders in tight loops — the Jing River stretch (荆江), nicknamed “nine twists of the intestine” (九曲回肠). Water drains slowly, so this is where floods are most dangerous.
clips.text: The Jing River bends & Dongting Lake. Below Yichang the river slows and wanders in tight loops — the Jing River stretch (荆江), nicknamed “nine twists of the intestine” (九曲回肠). Water drains slowly, so this is where floods are most dangerous.

clips.send: First Bend and Tiger Leaping Gorge. At Shigu in Yunnan the river makes a sudden U-turn — the “First Bend of the Yangtze”. Just below, it races through Tiger Leaping Gorge (虎跳峡), one of the deepest gorges in the world.
clips.text: First Bend & Tiger Leaping Gorge. At Shigu in Yunnan the river makes a sudden U-turn — the “First Bend of the Yangtze”. Just below, it races through Tiger Leaping Gorge (虎跳峡), one of the deepest gorges in the world.

clips.send: Shanghai: into the East China Sea. After about 6,300 km (3,900 mi) the Yangtze reaches the East China Sea at Shanghai. It is the longest river in Asia and the third longest in the world.
clips.text: Shanghai: into the East China Sea. After about 6,300 km (3,900 mi) the Yangtze reaches the East China Sea at Shanghai. It is the longest river in Asia and the third longest in the world.

clips.send: Yibin: “the first city on the Yangtze”. The Min River joins at Yibin (宜宾) in Sichuan. From here on the river is called the Chang Jiang (长江 “long river”) and bigger boats can sail.
clips.text: Yibin: “the first city on the Yangtze”. The Min River joins at Yibin (宜宾) in Sichuan. From here on the river is called the Chang Jiang (长江 “long river”) and bigger boats can sail.

clips.send: Chongqing: the mountain city. Chongqing (重庆), where the Jialing River joins, is the biggest port on the upper Yangtze. The Three Gorges reservoir stretches all the way back here — about 660 km (410 mi) from the dam, roughly Washington, DC, Boston.

clips.send: Source: Geladaindong glacier. The Yangtze begins as melt-water from glaciers on Geladaindong (各拉丹冬 Gèlādāndōng, 6,621 m), the highest peak of the Tanggula Mountains on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. The source stream is the Tuotuo River.

clips.send: Qutang Gorge — the first gorge. The Three Gorges (长江三峡) run about 193 km from Baidicheng (白帝城) to Nanjinguan near Yichang. First comes Qutang Gorge (瞿塘峡 Qútáng Xiá): only about 8 km long, but the narrowest and most dramatic.

clips.send: 宜宾：“万里长江第一城”。岷江在四川宜宾汇入，从这里开始称“长江”，江面变宽，可以通航。
clips.text: 宜宾：“万里长江第一城”。岷江在四川宜宾汇入，从这里开始称“长江”，江面变宽，可以通航。

clips.send: 上海：注入东海。长江全长约6300千米，在上海注入东海，是亚洲第一长河、世界第三长河。
clips.text: 上海：注入东海。长江全长约6300千米，在上海注入东海，是亚洲第一长河、世界第三长河。

clips.send: 瞿塘峡——三峡第一峡。长江三峡西起重庆奉节白帝城，东到湖北宜昌南津关，全长约193千米。第一峡是瞿塘峡，长约8千米，最短、最窄、最险。
clips.text: 瞿塘峡——三峡第一峡。长江三峡西起重庆奉节白帝城，东到湖北宜昌南津关，全长约193千米。第一峡是瞿塘峡，长约8千米，最短、最窄、最险。

clips.send: 玉树：金沙江开始。经过沱沱河、通天河，长江在青海玉树附近进入金沙江河段，向南穿行于横断山区的高山深谷之间。
clips.text: 玉树：金沙江开始。经过沱沱河、通天河，长江在青海玉树附近进入金沙江河段，向南穿行于横断山区的高山深谷之间。

clips.send: 长江第一湾与虎跳峡。在云南石鼓，江水突然掉头折向东北，形成“长江第一湾”。下游不远处是世界上最深的峡谷之一——虎跳峡。
clips.text: 长江第一湾与虎跳峡。在云南石鼓，江水突然掉头折向东北，形成“长江第一湾”。下游不远处是世界上最深的峡谷之一——虎跳峡。

clips.send: 重庆：山城。嘉陵江在重庆汇入长江。重庆是长江上游最大的港口城市。三峡水库的回水一直延伸到重庆附近，长约660千米。

clips.send: 源头：各拉丹冬雪山。长江发源于青藏高原唐古拉山脉主峰各拉丹冬雪山（海拔6621米）的西南侧，正源是沱沱河。

clips.send: 宜昌：上游与中游的分界。湖北宜昌是长江上游与中游的分界点。上游长约4500千米，江水从这里流出山区，进入江汉平原。
